description:
Siren is the thirteenth saint chosen by the church. On the altar, she witnesses the twelve former saints drained of their life force 🌊.
Rather than become the next sacrifice, she leaps into the endless abyss. Down in the dark ocean, she finds Leviathan, the sea god who has been robbed of his power and trapped for a thousand years.
The faith she devoted her whole life to is fake. The monster they feared is the true god.
She swallows the Heart of the Abyss and rises as the Queen of the Deep. Her song awakens his god core, and they share a life‑binding symbiotic bond.
Together, they march back to the Coral Isle, tear down the sacred altar, and avenge every girl killed by the church’s bloody ritual.
Behind the high priest’s cruelty lies a heavy secret for the whole island. A greater cosmic threat waits beyond the stars.

#TidesOfTheDeep #DarkFantasy #SeaGodRomance #AbyssQueen #SacrificeDrama #ShortDrama
